description: Import an open-source load test (JMeter .jmx, k6 .js, or Locust .py) into an existing script, converting it to Loadster commands. An import may create script assets, datasets, and a scenario; replace=true also replaces the script's existing commands and variables. Returns action items to review. For OpenAPI/Swagger or Postman, read the spec yourself and build commands with create_script instead.

baseUrl.description: Optional base URL to prefix relative requests.

content.description: The source file content (the .jmx XML, .js, or .py text).

replace.description: Replace existing commands (true) or append to them (false). Defaults to false.

scriptId.description: The script id to import into (create an empty script first).

source.description: The source tool: jmeter, k6, or locust.

name: import_script
title: Import Script
